Subject: Request: short extension + credit split for Atlas Retail POC

Hi Hannah —

Thanks again for the productive demo last week. You mentioned the team wants a little more time to validate the forecasting flows against higher-volume test prompts. We can do a short extension to the current POC; two options that we've used successfully with other retail teams: 

1) Time-box extension (3 weeks) at a flat, discounted rate — keeps the provisioning/pool reserved and includes an extra 40% usage buffer.
2) Credit top-up — immediate token/compute credits you consume, no additional reserved time. Credits are priced at a volume-discounted unit rate.

High-level pros: time-box is best when you need consistent load testing and a bump in SLO/capacity; credits are simpler if you want burst testing without extending the contract period.

I've attached a short addendum draft (pilot-addendum-v2.pdf) and a usage CSV showing current burn. Would you be open to the 3-week time-box at a 15% extension discount? If procurement prefers credits, we can suggest a 25k-credit top-up at a 10% effective discount.

If either works, I can route the addendum for a quick signature and lock the pool.

Thanks —
Laura Bennett
